core.headline: Two-bedroom maisonette, Streatham High Road SW16
core.listing:
A two-bedroom maisonette on the first and second floors above a commercial unit on Streatham High Road. The property has its own entrance via a rear service yard and a bay-fronted living room measuring 4.90m x 4.10m into bay (16'1" x 13'5" into bay). A section 42 lease extension notice has been served and can be assigned to the buyer.

The first floor comprises the living room with bay window to the front, a kitchen fitted in 2022 measuring 3.20m x 2.30m (10'6" x 7'7"), and bedroom one measuring 3.85m x 3.05m (12'8" x 10'0"). The second floor has bedroom two measuring 2.70m x 2.40m (8'10" x 7'10") and the bathroom.

Access is via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit below. There is a shared bin store. Parking is not available with the property; pay-and-display is available on adjoining roads.

Streatham station is approx. 6 minutes' walk and Streatham Common is approx. 10 minutes' walk.

Offers in Excess of £375,000. Leasehold with 89 years remaining; ground rent is £350 per year and doubles every 25 years, with the next increase in 2034; service charge is £960 per year (year ending December 2025, includes buildings insurance). Council Tax Band C (London Borough of Lambeth). EPC rating D. Construction is standard – brick under a slate roof. The property is above a dry cleaner's on a main road and there is some traffic noise to the front. The freeholder owns the shop below. Access is via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit, and there is a shared bin store. Chain involved.
core.summary: A two-bedroom maisonette with own entrance, bay-fronted living room and kitchen fitted in 2022. Section 42 lease extension notice served and can be assigned. Streatham station approx. 6 minutes' walk.
